name: S*S -Yuukai Shita ○ Gakusei o Love Love Ryoujoku!!-
original_name: S*S-誘拐した○学生をラブラブ凌辱!!-
source:
A weird guy juggling a few part-time jobs 
meets a young girl named Yui in the park one night. 
She's a cocktease no doubt; he doesn't let her cast her lure only to be tossed 
back in the water when he bites. However, while he does force himself 
on her, she gets off as deeply as him. This is a r*pe story 
about an unlikely couple who fit together like S and M. >:) 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE130412.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个奇怪的家伙同时做几份兼职工作 
一天晚上，在公园里遇见了一位名叫结衣的年轻女孩。
毫无疑问，她是个逗人喜爱的人。他不会让她施展诱惑却被扔掉 
当他咬人时又回到水里。然而，尽管他确实强迫自己 
在她身上，她和他一样深入。这是一个令人毛骨悚然的故事 
关于一对不太可能像S和M一样在一起的情侣。>:)
